document: 2026-10-21 FOC P1 current saved source connectivity snapshot; official ENET and API geometry agree on 169 components / 506 pins / 102 nets. Reopen after save NOT_VERIFIED. Exported RSO_W temperature-coefficient text is corrupted in API ENET only; saved P1 remains valid. Electrical qualification remains OPEN.
scope: 169-component/506-pin source snapshot from the saved official native project; compared against the official raw ENET and API geometry. Static connectivity matches the 169/506/15-NC/491-connected/102-net contract. Post-save reopen via a new API session was NOT_VERIFIED after two REQUEST_TIMEOUT results. Raw ENET contains two U+FFFD in RSO_W Temperature Coefficient; native P1 retains ±100ppm/℃, so not all exported attributes match. This does not qualify electrical behavior, BOM sourcing, thresholds, hardware, firmware, thermal/pulse capability, or PCB; external dump resistors and harness parts are excluded from PCB conversion.

components.note: Local bypass across DUMP_5V and GND_SYS; TDK C1608X7R1A104K080AE, 100nF/10V; effective capacitance remains subject to verification.
Native board connector; external mating cable plug is separately covered by the two-board assembly supplement.
BOV break-path PNP emitter now DUMP_5V so SAFE_5V failure does not remove this pull-up rail; low-current full-temperature behavior remains open.
BC847C clamp transistor pulls LM5008 RT/SD low when LOAD_POWER_VALID is absent; low-current/full-temperature saturation proof remains OPEN.
BC847C release transistor; base driven by LOAD_POWER_VALID through 4.7kΩ; local 100kΩ base pulldown retains default-off.
4.7kΩ series base resistor, one per FOC board; shared VO617A output current and BC847C full-temperature drive remain OPEN.
1kΩ shared optocoupler bias; install only on FOC-A, DNP on FOC-B.
1MΩ divider upper resistor; procurement MPN RC0603FR-071ML, LCSC C105578. Divider stress/threshold qualification remains open.
TLV1704 retains the three phase-negative channels; unused channel pins10=GND_SYS, 11=DUMP_5V, pin13=NC.
UCC27511 dump gate driver VDD=DUMP_5V; IN-=BUSOV_N, IN+=DUMP_THERM_OK. UVLO holds output low; hardware thermal/gate path acceptance remains open.
BUS-fed DUMP_5V regulator; independent of SAFE_5V while BUS is within operation range and U6 is healthy; candidate pending input/output capacitor effective-value and thermal checks.
DUMP_5V rail support part; Add into BOM and Convert to PCB are true. Candidate DC-bias, assembly, thermal, and exact source qualification remain open as applicable.

candidate_BOV_reference_option_20261021.status: implemented_in_current_saved_native_source; pin connectivity verified against official ENET and API geometry; post-save reopen NOT_VERIFIED
candidate_BOV_reference_option_20261021.basis: Native source saved true. New official ENET and API geometry agree on 169 components / 506 pins / 102 nets and all expected pin changes. New-session reopen timed out twice, so it is NOT_VERIFIED. The official ENET contains an RSO_W Temperature Coefficient text serialization defect (two U+FFFD) while saved P1 retains ±100ppm/℃; preserve raw export without normalization.

expected_after_source_change.calculation: Confirmed by official ENET component pin maps and API geometry: 170 + U7 + C_U7 - R_OVREF_TOP - R_OVREF_BOT - R_OV_HYS = 169; 504 + 6 + 2 - 6 = 506; U3 pin13 and U7 pin1 are NC, leaving 15 NC/491 connected; V_OV_REF is removed so 103 - 1 = 102 nets.

per_board_added.description: Use TLV6700 B comparator and internal 400mV reference; project MPN already used at regulator U_SC_OV.
Local VDD bypass DUMP_5V to GND_SYS.

candidate_bom_delta.official_bom: Current official API export written verbatim; 91 grouped rows / 156 board pieces. SHA256 7A6788F96E9E82A276CED672C02DA30BB3509B3EEB92C1B8CBB80E8005D8AB43. R_OVTOP sourcing field is corrected to C105578; no price/MOQ evidence.

threshold_screen.caveat: Independent divider/reference corner envelopes, not paired same-board turn-on/release values. Does not include INB- input current at 0.4V (not specified by TI at this condition), actual high-line DUMP_5V, parasitic effects, or hardware transients; screening only.

hysteresis_and_filter.external_feedback: Remove old 200k BUSOV_N-to-V_OV_REF resistor; it cannot be reused at VBUS_OV_SENSE because value and active polarity are wrong. Do not assume TLV6700 minimum hysteresis; it is unspecified.
hysteresis_and_filter.C_OV_SENSE: Retain 1nF C0G. New divider Thevenin resistance ≈9.90kΩ; τ≈9.90µs; 10–90%≈21.8µs. Filtering is not guaranteed DC hysteresis.

logic_and_failure_states.normal_bus: U7 OUTB high impedance; R_OV_PU raises BUSOV_N; U4 IN- high, so with DUMP_THERM_OK high output is low and Q7 is off.
logic_and_failure_states.overvoltage_and_thermal_contact_closed: U7 OUTB pulls BUSOV_N low; U4 IN+ high and IN- low, DUMP_DRV_OUT high, Q7 on. Existing Q_BOV_PNP/BC847C path independently asserts BREAK_N.
logic_and_failure_states.thermal_contact_open: U4 IN+ is pulled low; Q7 off even during BOV. Overvoltage still asserts BREAK_N through the separate BOV transistor path.
logic_and_failure_states.U7_unpowered_DUMP5_alive: OUTB goes high impedance; BUSOV_N is pulled high, so local BOV fails open.
logic_and_failure_states.DUMP5_lost: UCC27511A output is held low below its maximum 4.65V rising UVLO; dump path unavailable.
logic_and_failure_states.U7_startup: Output is guaranteed correct only after VDD exceeds 1.8V for up to 450µs; a BUS already above threshold during rail startup is an unresolved detection delay.
logic_and_failure_states.MCU_state: MCU GPIO is monitoring only; MCU high/low does not gate local BOV.

remaining_physical_inputs: Battery/BMS rejection regenerative BUS envelope: peak, slew rate, duration and repeated pulses.
Maximum-speed motor open-circuit and regenerative voltage/current envelope.
Exact external resistor pulse curve, thermal switch trip/reset temperatures and harness/fuse behavior.
DUMP_5V and Q7 VGS at 40–46V BUS, during high-temperature steady dump and startup/transient.
candidate_BOV_reference_option_20261021.qualification: Implemented connectivity only. Saved native source plus official ENET/geometry agree; new-session reopen after save NOT_VERIFIED. No physical, thermal, transient or full-temperature qualification. 1.8kW/1s per board and 3.6kW/1s two boards remain paper sizing targets, not a validated sink capability.
